component.name: Gearbench
component.summary: Lighting, G keys, DPI and macros for Logitech G keyboards and mice, and headset settings

description.p: Gearbench is a control panel for Logitech G keyboards (the G915, G915 TKL, G815, G515 TKL, G515 LIGHTSPEED TKL, PRO X TKL LIGHTSPEED, G213 Prodigy, G915 X, G915 X LIGHTSPEED, G915 X LIGHTSPEED TKL, G316 X, G316 X 98, G512 X 75 and G512 X 98), mice (the G502 X PLUS, G502 X, G502 X LIGHTSPEED, G502 X PLUS MILLENNIUM FALCON, G502 HERO, G502 LIGHTSPEED, G305, PRO X SUPERLIGHT, PRO WIRELESS, PRO X SUPERLIGHT 2, PRO X SUPERLIGHT 2 DEX, PRO X SUPERLIGHT 2c, PRO X2 SUPERSTRIKE, G203 LIGHTSYNC and G903 LIGHTSPEED HERO) and headsets (the G432, G431, G433, G533, G535, G633, G635, G733, G933, G935, PRO X Wireless, PRO X 2 LIGHTSPEED, G522 LIGHTSPEED and G325 LIGHTSPEED), and for the Astro A50 X, A50 Gen 5 and A50 Gen 4 headsets, the A50 Gen 4 with its base station's switch on PC. Only these models attach, the A50 Gen 4's Xbox edition not among them; the G913 TKL and G813 share the G915 TKL's and G815's ids and attach as those, the PRO X SUPERLIGHT 2 SE the PRO X SUPERLIGHT 2's, and the G102 LIGHTSYNC the G203 LIGHTSYNC's. The models not yet tested on the hardware are these: the G515 LIGHTSPEED TKL, G915 TKL, G815, PRO X TKL LIGHTSPEED, G213 Prodigy, G915 X, G915 X LIGHTSPEED TKL, G316 X, G316 X 98, G512 X 75 and G512 X 98 keyboards and the G502 X, G502 X LIGHTSPEED, G502 X PLUS MILLENNIUM FALCON, G502 LIGHTSPEED, PRO X SUPERLIGHT, PRO WIRELESS, PRO X SUPERLIGHT 2, PRO X SUPERLIGHT 2 DEX, PRO X SUPERLIGHT 2c, PRO X2 SUPERSTRIKE, G203 LIGHTSYNC and G903 LIGHTSPEED HERO mice, the G432's relatives but the G933, the G431, G433, G533, G535, G633, G635, G733, G935 and PRO X Wireless headsets, the Astro A50 Gen 5 headset, and the PRO X 2 LIGHTSPEED, G522 LIGHTSPEED and G325 LIGHTSPEED headsets. On a mouse other than the G502 X PLUS, G305 and G502 HERO, Gearbench writes nothing to the onboard profile until that is tested on the hardware. It talks to the keyboards, the mice and the G432 over their vendor HID++ 2.0 interfaces, on a cable or through a LIGHTSPEED receiver, and to the A50 Gen 4's base station over its own vendor HID interface, with no vendor software and nothing running as root. For each device it shows only what that device can do.

ul.li: Per-key and zone lighting, with the effects each keyboard's firmware has

G1 to G5 on the G915 and G815, and F1 to F12 on the G915 TKL and PRO X TKL LIGHTSPEED, bound to key combinations or macros, on the base layer and, from gearbench-ctl, the MR shift layer; G1 to G9 on the G915 X LIGHTSPEED, bound the same way on the base layer alone
Three M profiles, switched from the window, by the M1 to M3 keys, or, on a keyboard without them, from the tray's menu
Backlight brightness, snapped to a level the firmware keeps
DPI set live and remembered per model; the onboard DPI stage list and report rate rewritten on the G502 X PLUS, G305 and G502 HERO, and on the other mice the report rate set live in host mode
On each mouse but the G305, those of G4 to G9 it has, bound to key combinations, macros, DPI shift, DPI up, down or cycle, or the browser buttons, each model's on its own
Lighting where the mouse has it, either its own or following the keyboard
On the A50 Gen 4, microphone level, sidetone, noise gate and mic EQ
The A50 Gen 4's three EQ presets, edited band by band or imported from Astro Command Center's files
The A50 Gen 4's stream port mix, its base station's own settings and its battery
On the A50 Gen 4, changes apply at once; Save writes them to the base station's flash, and until then Revert to saved undoes all of them but Auto shut-off and which preset is active

The A50 Gen 4's and the A50 X's Game and Chat as two outputs, and Gearbench Spatial, a 7.1 output for games on the A50 Gen 4 and every other headset listed below, rendered for headphones from measured heads
On the G432, sidetone, noise suppression for its microphone, and Logitech G432 Equalizer, an output whose presets are edited band by band or copied from the A50 Gen 4's

On the G432's relatives, sidetone, noise suppression for the microphone and an equalizer, in the headset on the G633, G933 and G935 and on the computer on the others; the lights of the G633, G635, G733, G933 and G935; and on the wireless ones the battery and, on some, the time they power off after
On the A50 X, the sidetone, volume, Game and Voice balance, noise gate, auto sleep, tones, the base station's brightness and deep sleep, the stream mix and the headset's equalizers, and its battery
On the A50 Gen 5, the same less the deep sleep, read; nothing is changed until each change is tested
On the PRO X 2 LIGHTSPEED, through its receiver, the battery, sidetone, auto sleep, the microphone's noise reduction and the headset's equalizer, read; nothing is changed until each change is tested

On the G522 LIGHTSPEED, through its receiver or on its cable, and the G325 LIGHTSPEED, through its receiver, the battery, sidetone, auto sleep, eco mode and the headset's equalizer, and the G325's microphone noise reduction, read; nothing is changed until each change is tested

description.p: Game profiles hold a lighting and binding set that loads itself while a named program's window has focus, and macros are recorded from the Macros tab and replayed through a uinput virtual keyboard and mouse.

Lighting is volatile, but for the brightness the G515 TKL and the G915 X LIGHTSPEED keep through a power-off, as the G515 LIGHTSPEED TKL is taken to and the G915 X, G915 X LIGHTSPEED TKL, G316 X, G316 X 98, G512 X 75 and G512 X 98 may, and the keyboard's onboard profile is never written. Each write to the mouse's onboard profile, from the window or gearbench-ctl, backs up every profile sector first and reads the written sector back after. The A50 X keeps each setting written to it through a power cycle, the G432's adapter keeps its sidetone through an unplug, and the G432's relatives may keep theirs.
